CSV row excerpts from SPP public source files downloaded November 1, 2026. SourceFile identifies the original file; all other columns and values are source data. Each file contributes its first two rows with a non-null load/wind forecast. Paths: short-term files /2026/11/01/{hour+1:02d}/, hourly files /2026/11/01/. Public endpoint: https://portal.spp.org/file-browser-api/download/ using stlf-vs-actual, shortterm-resource-forecast, mtlf-vs-actual, midterm-resource-forecast, or resource-forecast-by-reserve-zone, respectively. Full source snapshots and capture manifest are in the local DST review artifacts.
